move.subject: Re: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
move.body:
Dear your company team,

Your brief quote and comment about getting back to the machines suggest you value a straightforward negotiation that leaves you time for production. We want to keep the discussion practical and establish a competitive price grounded in the part’s economics. How could greater flexibility on lead time help you sharpen your unit price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,000 units per year for 24 months. We have an offer at EUR 16.00 per unit (offer:DEMO-C1-0). Our should-cost estimate for this part is on record (cost:part:SH-220). Our demand forecast for this part is on record (fc:SH-220@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 12.51 per unit, 30 days payment, 42 days lead time, DAP). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

I saw your volume numbers and can drop the price to 15.40 EUR for DAP. Our offer is a price of €15.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery DAP. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. Hallo, 42 days lead time gives us some breathing room on the machines. With overtime we can deliver in 21 days, at a premium. 

We have free capacity for your parts. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

Dear partner,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We highly value the prospect of a long-term partnership and appreciate your confirmation of the 6,000 units annual volume. We have already taken that volume change data into account, and we have already taken that should cost data into account. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. 

Could you please share the detailed breakdown of your should-cost estimate so we can better understand the basis of your calculations?

Our current Angebot is a price of €16.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Alternatively, at our standard terms, with a price of €15.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 45 days, delivery EXW.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
